namespace = m

m.1 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.1.t
	trigger = {
		NOT = { any_child = { has_trait = bold } }
		v_rich_trigger = yes
	}
	immediate = {
		trigger_event = v.2
		v_effect = { AMOUNT = 3 }
		save_scope_as = mod_target
	}
	option = {
		name = v.1.a
		add_gold = 1
	}
}
m.2 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.2.t
	option = {
		name = v.2.a
		trigger_event = m.1
	}
}
